visual.description: Near-black background used throughout the entire page as the primary canvas.
Slightly lighter dark surface used for cards, panels, and sidebar elements.
Elevated surface color used for modal panels and issue detail cards.
Pure white used for primary headlines and key UI labels.
Medium gray used for body copy and descriptive paragraph text.
Dimmed gray used for secondary labels, timestamps, and inactive nav items.
Subtle dark border used to delineate cards, panels, and dividers.
Orange used for 'At risk' status indicators and priority warning badges.
Green used for 'On track' status indicators and active/complete states.
Purple/indigo used for agent avatars, Cursor agent branding, and scatter plot data points.
Blue used for interactive links, highlighted text in hero copy ('Purpose-built…'), and data points.
Light gray used for nav items, sub-labels, and secondary UI text.
White-background 'Sign up' CTA button with dark text, the primary call to action.
Blue submit/send button used in the comment input field.
Amber/gold used for the star/favorite icon on issue cards.
